subject: northern pygmy owl
title: An Owl the Size of a Soda Can Kills Birds Twice Its Weight

scenes.text: This owl is the size of a soda can. Birds twice its weight are on the menu.
The northern pygmy owl weighs about seventy grams, and it hunts in broad daylight.
It has taken northern flickers, woodpeckers weighing up to one hundred sixty grams, and quail.
It drops from a perch, grabs its prey, and kills with a bite to the neck.
Small birds gang up to chase it away. But it has a trick: two fake eyes on the back of its head.
Experiments show those false eyes cut down the mobbing. Even from behind, this owl is watching you.

description:
The northern pygmy owl weighs only about 62 to 73 grams, yet it hunts by day and takes birds such as northern flickers that can weigh more than twice as much, plus quail.
It has two dark false eyes on the back of its head; a 1999 study with owl models found the eyespots reduced mobbing by small birds.
Would you have guessed something this small was a top predator?
first_comment: Birds make up about 40% of its diet. Which small animal would you least want to fight if you were a bird?
